assumptions.choice: Implemented using Bollinger Bands (period=20, devfactor=2) only
assumptions.reason: Spec offers BB and Donchian as alternatives ('Alternatively, use a Donchian Channel...'); only one indicator set can define the single strategy class, and BB is listed as the primary method.

assumptions.choice: 3 consecutive lower highs and lower lows checked over the 4 bars immediately preceding the breakout bar (high[-1]<high[-2]<high[-3]<high[-4], same for lows)
assumptions.reason: Spec requires 'at least 3 consecutive lower highs and lower lows' before the breakout but gives no exact lookback window definition; this is the literal minimal reading of 3 consecutive decreases.

assumptions.choice: Average volume computed via SMA(volume,10) evaluated one bar back (vol_sma[-1]), i.e. the 10 bars preceding the breakout bar, excluding the breakout bar's own volume
assumptions.reason: Spec says volume must spike 'higher than the average volume of the last 10 periods'; excluding the breakout bar from its own baseline avoids self-referential bias and matches 'last 10 periods' as periods prior to the signal.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss trigger price set exactly at the channel lower band value at breakout time
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'below the lower band' with no numeric buffer specified; using the lower band level itself as the closest literal stop-trigger reference.

assumptions.choice: TP = actual filled entry price + channel height (upper-lower band width at breakout)
assumptions.reason: Spec: 'take profit target at a distance equal to the height of the channel... above the entry price'; used the real fill price (known only after order execution) rather than the signal-bar close.

assumptions.choice: Used the signal-bar close price as the entry price estimate for the risk/size calculation
assumptions.reason: Actual fill price is unknown until the market order executes at the next bar's open; sizing must be computed at signal time using the best available reference price.

assumptions.choice: risk_pct = 0.02 (2% of account equity per trade)
assumptions.reason: Spec gives 'e.g., 1% or 2%' without mandating a single value; chose 2% and exposed it as a tunable strategy parameter.

assumptions.choice: dd_threshold = 0.10 (10%), drawdown computed as (peak equity - current equity)/peak equity tracked from strategy start
assumptions.reason: Spec gives 'e.g., 10% of the account balance' without a fixed mandated value; chose 10% and exposed it as a tunable strategy parameter.

assumptions.choice: Implemented directly on the harness-provided 1h bar feed rather than an H4 chart
assumptions.reason: infeasible: the execution environment fixes a single 1h AAPL data feed with no resampling or additional data feeds available to the strategy class.

assumptions.choice: After entry fill, submit a limit sell (take profit) and a stop sell (stop loss) sized to the full position, linked via OCO so one cancels the other on fill
assumptions.reason: Spec states TP and SL levels but not order mechanics; OCO bracket-style exits are the standard way to implement simultaneous take-profit/stop-loss targets in backtrader.
